Translation Retargeting Options can be found in the Skeleton asset's 
Skeleton Tree.

The Retarget Source property sets the bind pose of a Skeletal Mesh 
that was used to author the animation. This property is found within 
the Animation Sequence's Details Panel.

Play or Simulate

Retarget Animations on the Same Skeleton

Play or Simulate

Copy Animations Across Similar Skeletons

The Animation Retargeting map provides several
examples on how to reuse animations between
different characters, regardless of proportions and
skeleton hierarchies.

Through the use of Translation Retargeting, IK
Rig, and IK Retargeter, the retargeting process
can be done either at runtime or for offline
creation of new animation assets.
